messages:
Leah: Opening a quick PR to replace the old SDK snippet for batching+cache with the new Optimize toolkit example — need UX wording for the "when to use" section.
Martin: Nice, thanks. Can you include a tiny before/after and a short diff example? Keep examples short.
Leah: Dropping draft snippet now. Note: this is intentionally minimal so readers can copy-paste.
Leah: ```python
# before: naive single request
resp = client.generate(model='redwood/gpt-std', input=input_text)
# after: use optimize client with batching + prefix cache
opt = OptimizeClient()
opt.batch([input1, input2], cache_prefix='user:123')
```
Sam: Tiny nit — use `opt_client` in snippet to avoid shadowing other examples. Also add one-line comment that KV-cache is per-session.
Leah: Good call, updating.
Alia: UX point: add one sentence about the tradeoff — batching reduces cost but can increase tail latency. Suggest phrasing like: "Consider batching for high-throughput pipelines; for latency-sensitive single-user flows prefer small batch sizes or prefix caching."
Martin: Also make sure we link to the quant profiles page and the SDK reference. CI will catch broken links but let's be proactive.
ci-bot: PR #4321 opened by Leah — https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4321 :white_check_mark: initial draft
Sam: I tried the preview locally — found a broken link to /docs/optimize/quantization-profiles (404). Looks like the page slug is /docs/optimize/quant-profiles now.
Leah: Thanks, will update all references in the PR. Any other quick asks?
Martin: For the migration checklist keep it three bullets: 1) back up existing prompts and config, 2) run smoke tests with representative prompts (include expected token delta), 3) have rollback plan + pinned model version.
Leah: Added checklist to PR with a sample smoke test prompt and a note to record token counts pre/post.
Alia: UX tweak — change "should" to "consider" in the caching guidance to avoid prescriptive tone.
Leah: Updated wording and pushed. :thumbsup:
docs-bot: Docs build succeeded — staging preview ready: https://staging.redwood.docs/optimize/snippets/4321 :eyes:
Sam: Preview looks good. I left one inline nit about variable naming in the snippet.
Leah: Fixed var name to `opt_client`, pushed again.
ci-bot: CI: link-checker ran — warning: /docs/optimize/old-cache-guide -> redirect found.
Martin: Replace that reference with the updated guide link and add a short redirect note so users know where to look.
Leah: Done. Anything blocking merge?
Sam: Approved. I'll merge once CI finishes and watch the deploy logs for link warnings.
ci-bot: PR #4321 merged by Sam — deploy queued to production docs.
Leah: Thanks all — I'll add a 1-line changelog entry and close the related ticket.
